backlog.title: v2.0 post-validation bug-fix changeset (BUG-001..003 + close-out)
backlog.description: Fix the three minor defects found by the v2.0 end-to-end validation of the current-turn-scoped implementation at /home/dustin/projects/pi-mulligan-current-turn-only: (BUG-001) restore the spec-verbatim REWIND_DESC checkpoint sentence and fix the checkpoint param description to reference the human /mulligan_checkpoint command; (BUG-002) implement the spec/08 E22 SHOULD-level identical-note advisory on the rewind success path (the two MUST-level hard backstops already exist); (BUG-003) add the five v1.1 integration scenarios (F-consent, F-ckptcmd, F-banner, F-useraudit, F-drift-userexempt) to the real-pi smoke suite so spec/11 DoD #2 is fully satisfied. Close out with the PRD's recommendation #4 (deprecate, do not delete, the dead agent-tool surface in src/tools/checkpoint.ts) and a changeset-level documentation sweep (README.md, VERIFICATION.md, scenarios.md). All three bugs were research-verified against source + spec (see plan/008_1c8ca4d1826d/bugfix/001_9420568ef08d/architecture/). Gates: npm test green, npx tsc --noEmit clean, npm run smoke 14 -> 19 scenarios.

milestones.title: Rewind tool surface: LLM-facing docs drift + E22 identical-note advisory (BUG-001, BUG-002)
milestones.description: Two independent fixes localized to src/tools/rewind.ts and its unit tests: restore the spec/05 §6 verbatim description strings (BUG-001) and add the spec/08 E22 SHOULD-level advisory that steers an agent out of a note-identical same-prompt rewind loop before the existing hard budget refuses (BUG-002). No behavior change from BUG-001 (strings only); BUG-002 never refuses and must not touch the existing maxDepth/maxRetriesPerPrompt/abortContextFraction backstops.

tasks.title: Fix mulligan_rewind LLM-facing docs drift (BUG-001)
tasks.description: REWIND_DESC (src/tools/rewind.ts:127-129) omits the spec-mandated final sentence about checkpoint granularity/consent, and the checkpoint parameter description (rewind.ts:112-114) references the removed v1 agent tool 'mulligan_checkpoint' instead of the human '/mulligan_checkpoint command'. Restore both strings byte-verbatim per spec/05-tools.md and update the hard-coded test assertion that pins the old string.

subtasks.title: Restore spec-verbatim REWIND_DESC checkpoint sentence + checkpoint param description (rewind.ts + rewind.test.ts)

CONTRACT DEFINITION:

RESEARCH NOTE: plan/008_1c8ca4d1826d/bugfix/001_9420568ef08d/architecture/bug_validation.md §BUG-001 — spec/05-tools.md:325 (§6 'Description strings') requires REWIND_DESC to END with (single leading space, em-dash): " granularity 'checkpoint' rewinds back to a checkpoint a user set — and may hide the user's prompts after it (they consented by setting it)." spec/05-tools.md:46-47 requires the checkpoint param description to be exactly: "Required when granularity=checkpoint. Strings only: no logic, schema-shape, or registration change. Gates: npm test green, npx tsc --noEmit clean.

The test update rides with this subtask.

tasks.title: Implement the E22 identical-note advisory on the rewind success path (BUG-002)
tasks.description: spec/08-edge-cases.md E22 'Advisory repeat-detection hint' (SHOULD) is unimplemented: when two consecutive rewinds re-land at the same prompt with substantively identical notes (same what_happened after trim/lowercase), the second rewind's success text must append the spec-verbatim warning. The two MUST-level hard backstops (maxRetriesPerPrompt at rewind.ts:570-581, abortContextFraction at 583-612) already exist, are unit-tested, and must remain untouched — the advisory only steers.

subtasks.title: Add prevRewindNoteAtLatestPrompt pure helper (cancel-aware, same-prompt slice) + fixtures
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: bug_validation.md §BUG-002 — spec/08-edge-cases.md:117 defines 'substantively identical' as same what_happened after trim().toLowerCase() (what_happened already absorbs avoid/lesson, so one field suffices), across TWO CONSECUTIVE rewinds re-landing at the same prompt. No new persistent state is needed: each mulligan:rewind marker's data.note already holds the raw NoteInput {what_happened, avoid, lesson, next?} on disk (src/markers.ts:80). countRetriesAtLatestPrompt (src/tools/rewind.ts:283+) already walks the exact slice needed.
2. INPUT: The ctx.sessionManager.getEntries() entry stream as used throughout rewind.ts: user message entries ({type:'message', message.role==='user'}), rewind markers ({type:'custom', customType:'mulligan:rewind', data:{id, seq, note?: NoteInput}}), cancel markers ({customType:'mulligan:cancel', data:{targetId}}).
3. LOGIC: Add an exported pure helper in src/tools/rewind.ts (suggest prevRewindNoteAtLatestPrompt(ctx): string | null): locate the LAST user-message entry; scan only the slice AFTER it (identical to countRetriesAtLatestPrompt's window); collect rewind markers NOT retired by a later mulligan:cancel (reuse the cancelledRewindIds / BUG-005 exclusion pattern already used at rewind.ts:220 and 283+); return the LAST surviving marker's data.note.what_happened normalized via trim().toLowerCase(), or null when there is no user prompt, no surviving rewind, or the marker lacks a note. Fail-open: never throw. Unit tests need a NEW fixture rewindEntryWithNote(seq, whatHappened) — the existing rewindEntry (test/tools/rewind.test.ts:207-209) carries no data.note.
4. OUTPUT: The exported helper + green unit tests (makeCtx/run/firstText harness conventions, test/tools/rewind.test.ts:181-195) for consumption by P1.M1.T2.S2.
5. DOCS: none — internal pure helper; no user-facing, config, or public-API surface change.

subtasks.title: Wire the advisory into rewindExecute success text (spec-verbatim warning, appended after k-clause/MUTATION_WARNING)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: bug_validation.md §BUG-002 — the advisory is SHOULD-level and STEERS only ('This steers; the budget/context-fraction stops above are what ultimately refuse', spec/08:117). Spec-verbatim advisory text: "⚠ You have rewound with an identical note — the re-attempt is reproducing the mistake. Change approach or shrink the offending result rather than rewinding again." The MUST backstops at rewind.ts:570-581 (step 4b) and 583-612 (step 4c) must remain byte-identical.
2. INPUT: prevRewindNoteAtLatestPrompt(ctx) from P1.M1.T2.S1; the current call's params.note.what_happened; successText(granularity, k, hasWarning) at src/tools/rewind.ts:179-187; the rewindExecute step sequence (486-717: step 7 appendRewindMarker at 631, step 9 success at 699-704).
3. LOGIC: In rewindExecute, compute the comparison BEFORE step 7's appendRewindMarker (so 'previous' means the prior marker — the current marker is persisted at step 7, before success returns at step 9): identical = helper(ctx) !== null && helper(ctx) === params.note.what_happened.trim().toLowerCase(). Extend successText's signature with the flag and append " " + the verbatim advisory AFTER the k-clause and MUTATION_WARNING so all three clauses can coexist. The advisory NEVER refuses and never changes the k-clause or warning behavior. Tests (mirror the retry-budget describe style at test/tools/rewind.test.ts ~1001-1016, using P1.M1.T2.S1's fixture): (a) second consecutive same-prompt rewind with byte-identical what_happened → advisory appended; (b) substantively different note → no advisory; (c) case/whitespace-only differences → advisory fires (normalization); (d) a NEW user prompt between the two rewinds → no advisory (not consecutive at the same prompt); (e) previous rewind cancelled via mulligan:cancel → no advisory; (f) advisory coexists with MUTATION_WARNING on the same success text; (g) zero-hide rewind (k=0, 'nothing matched to hide') still carries the advisory (E22 acceptance (c): it consumes budget and is the canonical loop vector). Gates: npm test, npx tsc --noEmit.
4. OUTPUT: rewindExecute success text conditionally carrying the advisory; observable end-to-end by P1.M2.T6.S1's smoke run and summarized by P1.M3.T2.S1/S2.
5. DOCS: none — agent-facing runtime output; no config knob is added (E22 advisory rides existing config) and no exported-type surface changes beyond successText's internal signature.

milestones.title: v1.1 integration smoke scenarios F-consent / F-ckptcmd / F-banner / F-useraudit / F-drift-userexempt (BUG-003)
milestones.description: Close the spec/10-testing.md §2.1 v1.1 gap so spec/11-build-order.md §3 DoD #2 ('All F-* integration scenarios green against a real pi -p run') is fully satisfied and the suite grows 14 → 19. The v1.1 logic is already unit-covered (test/commands.test.ts, test/banner.test.ts, D10 drift tests); what is missing is the end-to-end path (command dispatch → label entry → banner state → next context fire) driven through the existing two-extension harness (run-smoke.mjs + smoke.ts). Key researched constraints: headless pi -p has ctx.hasUI=false (banner/audit must be observed via pure recomputation and smoke-log observables, not setWidget/notify output); slash commands dispatch deterministically as -p '/cmd arg' prompts; checkpoints are Pi LabelEntries assertable via the existing labelActive() helper; the D10 user-paste exemption is structural (estimateAgentTokens excludes role==='user'), not a 50k constant.

Reuse the split-phase seed pattern proven by F-checkpoint-set/F-checkpoint-rewind (test/integration/smoke.ts:283-303): a SEED_ANCHOR model turn must commit BEFORE /mulligan_checkpoint so setCheckpoint's anchor walk (src/markers.ts:456-490, last message entry with non-empty role) finds a stable entry; a seeded turn must exist AFTER the checkpoint so the rewind hides something (K>0).

subtasks.title: Register + drive + assert F-useraudit (wrapper-ctx notify capture vs real agent tool; zero writes from the command)

Asserter: (a) the two smoke-logged report strings are IDENTICAL (same renderAuditReport output — compare normalized); (b) the command performed ZERO session writes (no new mulligan:* custom entries attributable to the command; no sendMessage artifacts) while the TOOL result DID reach the model (its tool-result entry exists in the JSONL); (c) assertGlobalInvariants.

tasks.title: F-drift-userexempt scenario (50k user paste does not fire drift; high-water does fire)
tasks.description: Proves the D10 user-paste exemption end-to-end: a very large USER paste with ~0 agent work does NOT fire the drift nudge (user content is excluded from the agent-attributable delta), while the high-water total-context signal DOES fire. The contrast criterion (agent reads DO fire drift) is cross-referenced from the existing green F-nudge-drift scenario rather than duplicated.

subtasks.title: Register + drive + assert F-drift-userexempt (big user paste via -p; hasNudge false; high-water observable true, soft on huge windows)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: bug_validation.md §BUG-003 nuances — the D10 exemption is STRUCTURAL: estimateAgentTokens (src/tokens.ts:126-143) excludes role==='user' messages from the drift delta ('50k' is illustrative, spec/07:174); there is no 50000 constant. A ~60k-token paste ≈ 240KB of argv is comfortably under Linux ARG_MAX (~2MB) — generate deterministic filler in run-smoke.mjs at runtime, do not check a huge fixture into the repo. The highWater {latch, fraction} observable from P1.M2.T1.S2 proves the total-context crossing. The contrast arm ('3 turns of agent reads ~4k each DO fire the drift nudge') is already proven by the existing green F-nudge-drift scenario — cross-reference it in the asserter notes instead of duplicating model-driven turns.
